description.value: Mangia's Sandwiches is a casual Italian-style deli on Granville Street, sister restaurant to Jo's Italian Deli, where meats are sliced to order and bread is delivered fresh daily from a local bakery. The menu spans Italian specialty sandwiches, hot sandwiches, and classic deli options, with several vegetarian choices. The shop also offers catering with sandwich platters, charcuterie boards, and individually packed bagged lunches.
